chapter: French Opera house and cello teachers
title: Exploring the French Opera building and its stage machinery
summary: He describes the opera house backstage, dressing rooms, trap system, the earlier burned theater and a childhood memory of an acrobat.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: And that's where, that's where the, uh, the opera was. You see? And when they built this new opera, uh, I don't know what took place, but it burnt down. And when it burnt down, it remained a lot there. And, uh, I remember I was a little child. I remember seeing, uh, uh, an acrobat by the name of a Frenchman. Baptiste Pignot.
